diaries.title: First Letter: The Creation
diaries.content:
My Love,

When we first met in Form 1, I was still a nerd, perhaps. Haha. Back then, I saw you as just an average girl. But whenever you talked about other boys, I would actually feel a little jealous. I knew that, at that time, I was probably not in your league, so from that day onwards, I stopped admiring you.

A few years later, I finally got a chance with you. But to be honest, at first, I wasn't trying to fall in love with you. I just wanted to try my luck and see where fate would take me. Haha, I'm sorry for being honest.

But after being with you for a while, I realised I couldn't lie to myself anymore. I knew that I wasn't just playing around, and I knew it would hurt you if you had already developed feelings for me. Then, a year later, I started flirting with you again. I don't even know what happened, but somewhere along the way, my feelings for you became more than just admiration.

And now, I have truly fallen in love with you.

And somehow, you are my girlfriend now. Honestly, I never thought that one day, you would be mine. From the girl I once thought was out of my league, to the person I now get to call mine, it still feels unreal sometimes.

I am who I am today because of you. You have become one of the biggest reasons behind my happiness, my hope, and my dreams. You mean more to me than I can ever properly explain.

I don't know what the future holds for us, but I know that I am grateful that fate somehow brought us here. From Form 1 until now, after all the years, all the changes, and everything that happened between us, I still can't believe that I ended up falling in love with you.

And now, I don't just admire you anymore.

I love you.

diaries.title: Second Letter: Fall Ill
diaries.content:
My dearest Raa,

I know you’re feeling really sick right now, and honestly, I’m really worried about you. I know you were supposed to sit for your Account exam today, and I can imagine how stressful and upsetting it must feel to miss it because you’re unwell.

But please don’t blame yourself too much, okay? Your health is more important than one exam. I know how hard you’ve worked, and I know you would have done your best if you were feeling well enough to go.

For now, please just rest and take care of yourself. Don’t worry about anything else. I really wish I could be there with you right now, taking care of you and making sure you’re okay.

Please get well soon, Raa. I love you so much, and I’m always here for you. ❤️

Love,
Rawr

diaries.title: Third Letter: For My Sick Love
diaries.content:
My dearest Raa,

I just wanted to write this little letter to you because I’ve been thinking about you a lot. I know you’re not feeling well right now, and honestly, I’m really worried about you. I wish I could be there beside you, taking care of you and making sure you’re okay.

Please rest properly, eat if you can, and don’t force yourself to do anything when your body needs to rest. I know you have things you need to do, but your health is more important right now, so please take care of yourself, okay?

I really hope you get better soon, Raa. It hurts me knowing that you’re feeling so sick and I can’t do much to help you. But please remember that you don’t have to go through it alone. I’m always here for you, even if all I can do is worry about you from afar.

So please get well soon, my love. Take all the time you need to rest and recover. I love you so much, Raa, and I just want to see you feeling happy and healthy again ❤️🥺

With all my love,
Warun ❤️

diaries.title: Fourth Letter: Thank You for Being in My Life ❤️
diaries.content:
My dearest Raa,

Today, I don't want to write about sadness or worries. Instead, I just want to tell you how grateful I am to have you in my life.

Thank you for choosing to stay. Out of everyone in this world, you chose to spend your days with me, and that is something I will never take for granted. You may think that what you do is small, but every little thing you do means so much to me. Your messages, your laughter, your care, and even the moments we simply stay on call without saying much have become parts of my happiest days.

Before you came into my life, I never imagined someone could make an ordinary day feel so special. Somehow, you do it so effortlessly. Just knowing you're there is enough to make my day a little brighter.

Thank you for accepting me with all my flaws. I know I'm not perfect, and there are times when I make mistakes or don't know the right thing to say. Yet you still choose to be here. Your patience, kindness, and love are gifts I treasure every single day.

I hope you know how proud I am of you. No matter what you're going through, I will always believe in you. I want to be the person who celebrates your happiest moments and stands beside you during your hardest ones.

If one day you ever wonder whether you are appreciated, let this letter be your answer. You are. More than you could ever imagine.

Thank you for becoming one of the most beautiful chapters of my life. I don't know what the future holds, but I do know that meeting you is something I will always be thankful for.

So, if I don't say it enough, let me say it now.

Thank you for existing.
Thank you for choosing me.
And thank you for making my life so much happier simply by being in it.

With all my love,

Warun ❤️

diaries.title: Fifth Letter: I Really Love You ❤️
diaries.content:
My dearest Raa,

I don't think I say this enough, but I really, really love you. Sometimes I wonder how someone could become such an important part of my life in such a short time. Somehow, you did.

I love the way you make my ordinary days feel special. I love your voice, your laugh, your little habits, and even the moments when you annoy me a little. I love you not because everything is always perfect, but because even when things aren't perfect, you're still the person I want in my life.

You mean more to me than I can properly explain. I may not always know how to show it, and sometimes I may make mistakes, but please never think that my love for you isn't real. It is. I love you more than words can ever truly express.

Thank you for being you, Raa. Thank you for being someone I can love, care for, and call mine. I don't know what the future will bring, but right now, I just want you to know one thing.

I really love you. More than you know. ❤️

With all my love,
Warun ❤️

diaries.title: Sixth Letter: Message for You ❤️
diaries.content:
My dearest Raa,

I want to make you a promise. I promise that I will try to change and become a better person, not just for you, but for myself too.

I know I have made mistakes, and I know there are things I need to improve about myself. I may not be able to change everything overnight, but I promise I will try. I will learn from my mistakes, listen to you better, and be more careful with your feelings.

I don't want to keep hurting you and then simply say sorry without changing anything. I want my actions to show you that I truly mean it. I know I won't become perfect, but I promise I will keep trying to become someone better for us.

Please be patient with me as I learn and grow. I really love you, Raa, and I don't want to lose something as precious as what we have.

I promise you, I will change. Slowly, sincerely, and for the better. ❤️

With all my love,
Warun ❤️

diaries.title: Seventh Letter: About My Day
diaries.content:
My dearest Raa,

Today, I spent almost the whole day working on something for you. I spent my time adding new features and making changes to your website, just to make it a little more special for you.

Maybe some of the things I added are small, and maybe you might not notice every little detail. But behind every feature, every line of code, and every little change, there was a thought of you.

I know it's just a website, but it's something I made especially for you. I wanted to create a little place that belongs to you, where you can read my letters and maybe find something new whenever you visit.

I really hope you love the new features, even if they may seem simple. I spent my whole day working on them because you are someone worth spending my time on.

And if you ever wonder what I did today, well... I spent most of it making your website a little better. ❤️

I sincerely hope you love it, Raa.

Sincerely,
Warun ❤️

diaries.title: Eighth Letter: The Story of Odysseus 🏛️
diaries.content:
My dearest Raa,

Today, I want to tell you about the story of Odysseus.

Odysseus was a man who spent many years travelling far away from home. He faced storms, danger, temptations, and countless challenges along the way. His journey was long and difficult, but through everything he went through, there was always one place he wanted to return to.

Home.

And perhaps that is what makes his story so beautiful. No matter how far he travelled or how many things he faced, his heart still remembered where it belonged.

Sometimes, I think love can be a little like that too. Life may take us through difficult moments, misunderstandings, and challenges. We may not always know what the future holds, but I hope that no matter how difficult things become, we will always find our way back to each other.

I don't want to compare myself to Odysseus, because I am certainly not a hero from an ancient story. But if there is one thing I can learn from him, it is this: no matter how long the journey is, some people are worth finding your way back to.

And for me, Raa, you are one of those people. 

With all my love,
Warun

diaries.title: Nineth Letter: If We Were Born a Hundred Years Ago
diaries.content: Sometimes I wonder what would happen if we were born a hundred years ago. No phones. No internet. No WhatsApp. No Instagram. No way for me to randomly text you at 2 AM just because I suddenly thought about you. Hahaha. I think our relationship would be so different. If I wanted to talk to you, I couldn't just open my phone and type, "What are you doing?" I would actually have to sit down, take a piece of paper, and write everything I wanted to tell you. And knowing me, I probably wouldn't stop at one page. I'd probably write you a whole poem in every letter. Imagine you opening the envelope and expecting a normal letter from me, only to find three pages of me talking about how I missed you, how my day went, some completely random story, and then suddenly there's a terrible poem at the end. And you'd probably be like, "Why did you write a poem again?" HAHAHA. But honestly, I think there's something beautiful about that. Back then, if I missed you, I couldn't just call you. I'd have to write it down. I'd have to wait for the letter to reach you, and then wait even longer for your reply. Every letter would become something worth keeping. Maybe I'd even keep every letter you sent me in a little box somewhere, because I wouldn't want to lose a single one. And maybe years later, we'd sit together and read all those old letters again, laughing at how stupid some of our poems were and remembering all the little things we used to talk about. I think that's what makes the idea so special to me. Even without the internet, somehow, I'd still find a way to talk to you. I'd still want to know how your day went. I'd still want to hear about the little things that happened to you. I'd still want to make you laugh. The only difference is that instead of a notification saying you replied, I'd hear a knock on the door and find a letter with your handwriting on it. And honestly... I'd probably be ridiculously excited every single time. So if we were born a hundred years ago, I guess I wouldn't have a chat with hundreds of messages between us. I'd just have a stack of letters. And somehow, I think I'd be okay with that. Because as long as those letters were from you, I'd still feel like I had my favourite person to talk to.

diaries.title: Happy Third Monthsary
diaries.content:
Dear Raa,

Happy 3 monthsary, my love. 🤍 Three months might sound like a short time, but when I look back at everything we've shared, it feels like we've already collected so many little memories together. The random conversations, the silly moments, the late nights, the days where we did absolutely nothing but still enjoyed having each other around, and even the moments when things weren't perfect. Somehow, all of them became part of our story.

Thank you for being someone I can share my days with. Thank you for listening to my random thoughts, putting up with my weirdness, and staying through the moments when I'm not always the easiest person to understand. I know we both have our own flaws and there will always be days where we misunderstand each other, but I hope we never stop trying to understand one another.

Sometimes I think about how we were just two people who happened to meet, and now you have become such a meaningful part of my life. It's honestly a little crazy to think about. Out of all the people in this world, somehow our paths crossed, and somehow we ended up here, celebrating three months together. I'm grateful for that more than I can properly explain.

I don't know what every day in the future will look like, but I hope we continue making small memories together. More dates, more random conversations, more laughter, more pictures, more stupid jokes, more nights where we don't want the conversation to end, and more moments that we'll eventually look back on and say, 'Remember when we did that?'

Three months isn't the end of anything. It's just another little milestone in our story. And I'm really happy that this chapter has you in it. Thank you for these three months, for the memories we've already made, and for all the moments still waiting for us.

Happy 3 monthsary, sayang. 🤍 Here's to us, to everything we've been through so far, and to whatever comes next. I hope no matter how much time passes, we never forget how this chapter started. I love you, always.

Sincerely,
Warun

diaries.title: Thank You for Everything ❤️
diaries.content:
Thank you so much for the sandwich you made for me. I genuinely loved it, and honestly, your sandwich just hits different because you made it for me. I really appreciate the effort and thought you put into it. Even something as simple as a sandwich means a lot to me when it comes from you.

And about the birthday gift, even though it came a little late, I still really appreciate it. You still took the time to choose something for me, and that means more to me than whether it was on time or not. The wallet design is honestly so nice. I really love it, and I’m happy to have something from you that I can actually use and keep with me.

And the card you wrote for me... I really appreciate that too. Reading what you wrote made the gift feel even more special because it came from you. I’ll keep the card because it’s something I can look back at whenever I miss you or want to remember this moment.

Thank you for all these little things you do for me. Sometimes you might think they’re small, but they really do mean a lot to me. I love the sandwich, I love the wallet, I love the card, but most of all, I love that they came from you. ❤️
